cards.exampleTranslation: Thank you very much for your kind help.

cards.exampleSentence: Un café con leche, por favor.

cards.exampleTranslation: I left the car parked nearby.

cards.exampleTranslation: On Monday I start the course.

On Fridays I go out with friends.

cards.exampleSentence: El domingo como con la familia.
cards.exampleTranslation: On Sunday I eat with my family.
